So the prologue must occur in [[1006 BBY]]. *[[1003 BBY]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the start of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|Darth Bane Trilogy]] to [[1003 BBY]].–[[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]The book ends with the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] with the [[The Essential Atlas]] dates to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. |series=''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'' |preceded by=[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] |followed by="[[Darkness Shared]]" }} '''''Darth Bane: Path of Destruction''''' is a novel by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] about the life of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], set from [[1006 BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. The hardcover was released on [[September 26]], [[2006]] by [[Del Rey]]. The paperback contains an excerpt from [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]. A new audiobook was released by Random House Audio on the 30th of October 2012, narrated by Jonathan Davis. The novel was republished on [[June 15]], [[2021]] as part of ''[[The Essential Legends Collection]]''.
